name: call-of-cthulhu-plugin
description: Create and revise populated guest Call of Cthulhu investigators individually or in batches, roll dice and share private play-session events.

interface.longDescription: Create complete, editable Call of Cthulhu 7th edition investigators individually or in batches, with custom assigned stats, skills and backstories. Revise an explicitly attached sheet without replacing unrelated fields. No account required. Drafts stay in your browser where supported; the sheet confirms local saving and JSON export is an optional backup. Custom builds are not verified rules-legal. Roll dice inline and optionally share dice events through a private guest play session. Cloud saving and cross-device sync are not included.
defaultPrompt: Open my Call of Cthulhu investigator sheets.
Create five characters, each with different stats, skills, and backstory.
